items.title: NVIDIA Looks Expensive Until You Ask What Has To Ship
items.summary: Consensus turns today's multiple into a much lower one within two years, and by management's own account the constraint on getting there is capacity rather than demand.

items.title: VYM Is Beating the S&P 500 With a 17% Year-to-Date Return by Owning What Wall Street Won’t
items.summary: A mechanical yield screen is quietly outpacing the S&P 500 this year by excluding most of the AI complex before a single share is purchased, and the valuation gap it creates raises a question worth answering before the rotation reverses.

items.title: Prediction: Marvell’s New AI Catalyst Could Drive 21% Upside
items.summary: Marvell's AI infrastructure business just posted record data center revenue and management keeps raising its multiyear outlook, yet the stock still sits well below its 52-week high. Here is what the numbers say about whether the rally has room left to run.

items.title: Credo Is Up 71% This Year and Wall Street Just Raised Its Targets Again
items.summary: Credo Technology has turned into one of the wildest AI infrastructure trades of the year, but with the stock sitting near all-time highs and customer concentration severe enough to rattle any single hyperscaler pullback, the real question is whether the next leg up or a sharp reversal comes first.

items.title: OpenAI Is Burning $12.3 Billion a Quarter and the Rival It Created Just Passed It
items.summary: Anthropic was built by people who left OpenAI, and now it has quietly flipped a metric that makes OpenAI's massive spending look less like a moat and more like a gamble with consequences for every chipmaker in the supply chain.

items.title: Why Moderna Stock’s Historic Surge Is a Big Lesson for Markets
items.summary: Many Fed officials favor raising rates to combat inflation, bond prices surge, Trump meets crypto execs, and more news to start your day.

items.title: The Upside Case For Qualcomm Stock Now Carries Purchase Orders
items.summary: Qualcomm's non-handset business is inflecting fast enough that management expects it to replace the revenue Apple is taking away, and the first proof of that arrives in the December quarter.

items.title: Broadcom Holds Steady as ARK Buys the Dip, Intel Slips, AMD Eases After Google’s Marvell Chip Deal
items.summary: Google just handed Marvell a $12.2 billion equity-linked custom-chip deal, and Broadcom shareholders are left wondering how much of their AI revenue story walked out the door with it.
